hypothesis: When the accepted rotation state-surface queue has rank 1 and rank 2 both in Technology, the sector-cohesion state identifies a stronger rank-2/3 follow-through basket than the generic rank-notional stack.
interpretation: Top-2 Technology sector cohesion improves the default-off state-surface paper overlay in two windows without EV regression or drawdown drift. It slightly increases positive PnL concentration, so this is an incubation improvement rather than live promotion evidence.
